title: Service Endpoints
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://typeface.readme.io/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

To connect programmatically to Typeface APIs, you use an endpoint. An endpoint is the URL of the entry point for the Typeface services.

# Global Services Endpoint   [Skip link to Global Services Endpoint](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/apis-service-endpoints\#global-services-endpoint)

Global services have a single-entry endpoint. Global services are primarily used for authentication and discovery.

Only below listed APIs use a well-known Global endpoint. All other resources can be accessed through the links available in the response. Since Typeface APIs follow [HAL](https://stateless.group/hal_specification.html) model, it avoids the client to hardcode any endpoint except the well-known APIs.

1. [Get Access Token](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/post_oauth2-token)
2. [Discover](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/discoveridentity-1)
3. [Get teams by OrgId](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryaccountsinorg)

| Global Hostname used in well-known endpoints |
